kind: Post-selection falsification diagnostic, not a new strategy or a rescan
problem: A state-availability cash rule can remove losing sessions from the candidate but not the baseline. Isolate that effect before crediting the economic risk overlay.
test: Apply exactly the candidate's finite-state mask to frozen v1254, without changing baseline size, dates, fills or costs. Compare candidate MDD and daily expected-shortfall loss to this common-availability baseline in 2024-2025 separately for 9bp, 18bp and one-bar delay. Retain the already frozen 20% MDD and 15% tail-loss reduction thresholds. No parameter reranking or refit.
decision: A failed paired comparison invalidates risk-improvement attribution; preserve original records but do not advance it to native overlay null or execution. Global and inherited-anchor failures remain.
